text: Gentlemen, one of the main rules of your life should be, if someone doesn't want me, I shouldn't want them either. Let's say you're seeing this girl. Things seem good, then suddenly she pulls away. I'm not ready for a relationship, let's just be friends, or you are nice but I need a break. In movies, this is where the guy fights for her love, grand gestures, speeches, proving he is worthy. Real life, it doesn't work like that. If someone doesn't want you, you shouldn't want them either. Attraction isn't an addition. You are not here to compete for her attention. She should already see your value without you begging for it. Now, that doesn't mean she must accept you no matter what. You still need to be someone. A man with goals, hobbies, ambition, and self-respect. Someone who is building a life so good, she wants to be a part of it. Because when you already have something going for you, the right woman won't need convincing. She'll choose you without much hesitation. So here's the rule. If you are not enough for someone as you are, and you need to fight for her attention, especially with other guys, it's your sign that this person is not right for you. Respect yourself enough to walk away from that.
